sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
If a driver or rider has a medical condition that affects their ability to drive or ride safely, or they reach a certain age, they are required to have a health professional assess their Fitness to Drive on a regular basis. If there is a change in their health circumstances, TfNSW needs to be notified.
The Online Medical Form project provides a solution for Health professionals to complete and submit online forms related to supporting Fitness to Drive decisions for Transport.
The forms have a real time interaction between the health professional's medical practitioner systems and TfNSW.
TfNSW expects the vendor to provide the following key components:
1. Form Specification and Design: Working with TfNSW stakeholders to define/refine the assessment forms, noting a need to drive continuous improvement and increased automated processing rates.
2. Form Build: Working from the form specifications to build the assessment smart forms.
3. Form Hosting: Hosting assessment forms and facilitating access to all vetted Health Professionals, via commercial practice management software and the vendor's own website/application.
